claims.statement: The checklists collection has drafts with up to 50 versions and live preview; visitors read only published documents, panel users create and update, and deletion uses adminOrNotImported('importSnapshot') so editors delete only checklists the import did not create.
The checklists collection disables duplication because a copy would carry the same step identifiers and share progress.
legacyHref, the Squarespace link, is shown only while the checklist's state is preparing, and order is locked once set.
A step's text is a list of segments whose kind is plain, stop (with a quest and an objective index), resolve (with the stepIds it closes) or one of the guide callouts note, tip, must and includes.

A Necesitás row is a game item or a text label, with a quantity, alternatives, one of six categories and an optional group, whether it counts in the totals, whether it is reusable, and the quests that need it; validateNeedItem requires an item or a non-blank label.

A beforeValidate hook assigns each step its stepId: the one of its saved row, else the one it brings if unused, else the one of the saved step with the same legacyNumber, else a new UUID, never repeating an identifier.
A stop segment's objective must be a non-negative integer smaller than the number of objectives in its quest's stored stages, flattened stage by stage; a quest without objectives is rejected.
A resolve segment, a step's closes and updates, and an optional quest's finishing step may only name steps of the same checklist; a resolve segment with no steps resolves its own step.
A prerequisite row's key keeps its saved value through keepSavedValue, and rememberRowsWithoutId stops a row sent without an id from replacing a saved key.

pnpm import:checklists reads silvestre-checklist from --from, refuses remote or production databases without their flags, always runs a dry pass that prints unmatched references and rows kept as text, and writes only with --apply.
A ported checklist is created as a draft in preparing state, while catalog entries that are not ported are created published, preparing and without steps, linking to Squarespace.
toChecklistDraft cuts each step's text into segments around its highlights and throws when the segments do not rebuild the original text.
On a rerun the import rewrites a field only when its stored value still equals the importSnapshot, and tracks step zones per stepId so a new zone arrives while a zone Torre changed stays.
Checklist art that is not in DofusDB is uploaded to Media once under a silvestre-checklist-img key in media.gameAsset, so reruns never duplicate files.
A checklist's kind is steps (the default) or souls, and a souls checklist names the quest whose souls are ticked in soulsQuest, shown only for that kind.
A stop can also mark that a later step finishes the quest, carry its own line and resume line, and list further stops in more, whose quest is required.
A step's visible fields are placed in four unnamed tabs (Texto, Misiones, Necesitás, Imágenes) that only arrange the panel form, with the stepId in a collapsed technical section after them.
completedBy lists quests the game finishes on its own once all the listed quests are done, so they show as done without being ticked.
A «Detente aquí» segment may go without a quest and then only warns, while each stop in «Más paradas» requires its quest.

The catalog ports the Silvestre, Hielos, Nebuloso and the Rush de todos los Dofus with their steps and the Ocre as a souls checklist; for a souls entry the import writes only the entry fields, kind, soulsQuest and legacy, and reports the soul count and missing or incomplete monsters.

Generic rows of the old checklist (the class quest and alt:<achievement>:<objective>) get their quests from the DofusDB achievement objective's criterion; the row keeps the first quest with a label and the others as alternatives, and a row without quests is left out.
When Torre has a draft in progress, or a link entry is ported for the first time, the import writes its changes to a draft instead of publishing them.

A checklist step lists the Dofus guides of the Dofus it gives in its dofus field, and the import fills it from the old checklist's DOFUS_ROAD by Dofus item name, throwing when a road entry names a step that does not exist.
A checklist's dofusGuide is optional: the rush entry has none, and its card carries a gold color and a crown of up to six Dofus guides.
The ambience field picks the particles behind a checklist page (egg, snow, forest or theme, default egg), and the import writes the catalog's ambience only when it creates the checklist.
A souls checklist's soulOverrides rows give one monster this list's own dungeon, zone or region text or hide it, while the soul's name, level and image are corrected on the monster.
When a step has several green marks, the import gives each closed step to the green that names its quest's step number, and throws when a closed step has no such green or more than one.
Saving or deleting a checklist expires both the checklists and dofus-guides cache tags, and a slug change adds a redirect from the old address.
Checklists carry a hidden contentUpdatedAt date that the trackContentDate beforeChange hook sets when a panel user publishes a content change.
